title: 第19章 今夜看谁能救你第20章 啊丞你一定不会有事的
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
张文眉头紧皱的说道：“凭什么相信你！”
沐梓丞捂额，但还是冷静了一下情绪继续说道：“其实吾是你们丞相的朋友，你们是看不见吾的，只有你们丞相才能看见吾，现在唯一的目的就是想办法救出你们的丞相…”
俞月白依旧不信的说道：“荒唐，骗鬼呢！”
沐梓丞耐着性子继续说道：“你记不记得你喝醉酒那天闯进你们丞相的房间，然后你还跑进你们丞相的浴桶里，而后是不是还被摁在水里灌，摁你的人是吾。”
俞月白眼睛瞪得老大，什么？他摁的？！俞月白一脸的质疑的说道：“这…这不是女神摁的吗？”
张文黑着脸拽着俞月白的领子质问道：“什么？你竟然进丞相房间还进丞相的浴桶里！！你是不是不想活了！”
俞月白有些慌张的解释道：“不…不是…这…这不是本公子当时喝醉了嘛~我无意的呀…”
沐梓丞不耐烦的说道：“能别吵了吗，现在最重要的是救你们丞相要紧。”
张文甩开俞月白瞪了他一眼说道：“下次再跟你算账。”
俞月白还是不死心的说道：“本公子还是不信，说不定你当时就是躲在女神的房间看到了！”
沐梓丞‘啧’了一声，他真的好想直接揍到他们同意为止，解释这东西真是太麻烦了。
沐梓丞说道：“还有你，你之前跟丞相在阳城的时候，你跟丞相坐一桌吃饭，吃完之后不久你是不是拉了一晚上肚子，菜里面是吾下了巴豆。”
俞月白一脸的疑问说道：“你是在谁？？”
张文一脸的黑线，咬牙切齿的说道：“原来如此，怪不得怎么无缘无故拉了一晚上的肚子，你看在下怎么收拾你！！！出来，你看在下打不死你！！”
俞月白随即拦住了暴躁如雷的张文，便道：“你别激动呀，你不就拉了一晚上肚子嘛…本公子还差点被摁在水里淹死呢！！”
张文瞪了一眼俞月白，一脸埋怨的眼神随即说道：“你还说！！”
张文很是不爽，他拉了一晚上肚子都要拉的虚脱了，他还以为是不是吃错了东西，但是他也没吃什么竟然难受了一晚上，原来是他在菜里下了巴豆，这气真是不打一处来。
张文心情很是不爽的说道：“你在哪，人都看不见！有本事你就现身呀。”
沐梓丞真的怕忍不住自己直接去硬闯救人算了，怎么这些人这么的麻烦，他最后一脸黑线的说道：“不都说了你们是看不见吾的吗，能不能先想想办法怎么救人要紧？？嗯？！”

山寨里。
昔小苑躺在床上突然被人给拉了起来，进来了几个女子，还抬了热水进来倒浴桶里，昔小苑一脸的懵逼，这是要干嘛？？
昔小苑挣扎的说道：“你们这是干嘛呢！带我去哪！”
下人说道：“请夫人沐浴更衣，今夜夫人可要跟大王成亲呢~”
昔小苑抵抗着说道：“我不！我不——”
最后昔小苑被带到了里边的浴桶旁，昔小苑叫着说道：“别…别脱我衣服…我…我自己能来，你们都出去！”
下人继而说道：“大王吩咐了，一定要给夫人沐浴更衣好了才可以…”
昔小苑一脸慌张的说道：“我自己能来，如果你们再不出去的话我…我就咬舌自尽！”
她可不喜欢被人看着洗澡，而且还帮她脱衣服？？不，她坚决不同意。
昔小苑伸出舌头然后故意咬着，下人们有些大惊失色，随后看昔小苑那真要咬下去的认真样子，最后还是同意了。
昔小苑一个人看着浴桶里飘着淡淡的雾气，还有玫瑰花瓣在上面漂浮着…
content_en:
Zhang Wen frowned and said, "Why should I believe you?"
Mu Zicheng covered his forehead, but calmed down and continued: "Actually, I am your Prime Minister's friend. You cannot see me. Only your Prime Minister can see me. My only purpose now is to find a way to rescue your Prime Minister..."
Yu Yuebai still said in disbelief: "It's ridiculous, you're a liar!"
Mu Zicheng continued patiently: "Do you remember the day you were drunk and broke into your Prime Minister's room, and then you ran into your Prime Minister's bathtub, and then you were pressed into the water and poured into the water. I was the one who held you down."
Yu Yuebai's eyes widened, what? Did he press it? ! Yu Yuebai said with a questioning look on his face: "Isn't this... isn't this done by the goddess?"
Zhang Wen pulled Yu Yuebai's collar with a dark face and asked, "What? You actually entered the Prime Minister's room and even entered the Prime Minister's bathtub!! Do you not want to live anymore!"
Yu Yuebai explained in a panic: "No...it's not...this...isn't this young master drunk at the time~I didn't mean to..."
Mu Zicheng said impatiently: "Can you stop arguing? The most important thing now is to save your Prime Minister."
Zhang Wen shook off Yu Yuebai, glared at him and said, "I'll settle the score with you next time."
Yu Yuebai still refused to give up and said: "I still don't believe it, maybe you were hiding in the goddess's room and saw it!"
Mu Zicheng made a 'tsk' sound. He really wanted to beat them until they agreed. It was too troublesome to explain this thing.
Mu Zicheng said: "And you, when you and the Prime Minister were in Yangcheng, you and the Prime Minister sat at the same table for dinner. Not long after eating, you had diarrhea all night, and I drank croton in the dish."
Yu Yuebai said with a question on his face: "Who are you??"
Zhang Wen had a black line on his face and gritted his teeth and said: "I see, no wonder I had diarrhea for no reason all night, you see how I deal with you!!! Come out, you see I can't beat you to death!!"
Yu Yuebai immediately stopped the furious Zhang Wen and said: "Don't get excited, you just had diarrhea all night... I almost got pushed into the water and drowned!!"
Zhang Wen glared at Yu Yuebai, and then said with a complaining look on his face: "You still say that!!"
Zhang Wen was very unhappy. He had diarrhea all night and was almost exhausted. He thought he had eaten the wrong thing, but he didn't eat anything and felt uncomfortable all night. It turned out that he had put croton in the dish. He was so angry.
Zhang Wen said in a very unhappy mood: "No one can see you wherever you are! Just show up if you can."
Mu Zicheng was really afraid that he would not be able to help himself and just rush in to save people. Why are these people in such trouble? He finally said with a black face: "Didn't I tell you that you can't see me? Can you think of a way to save people first? Huh?!"

In the cottage.
Xi Xiaoyuan was lying on the bed when someone suddenly pulled her up. Several women came in and brought hot water to pour into the tub. Xi Xiaoyuan looked confused. What was going on? ?
Xi Xiaoyuan struggled and said: "What are you doing! Where are you taking me!"
The servant said: "Ma'am, please take a bath and change clothes. Tonight, my wife is getting married to the king~"
Xi Xiaoyuan resisted and said: "I don't! I don't -"
Finally, Xi Xiaoyuan was brought to the bathtub inside. Xi Xiaoyuan shouted: "Don't... don't take off my clothes... I... I can come by myself, you all get out!"
The servant then said: "The king has ordered that the lady must be bathed and dressed before..."
Xi Xiaoyuan said in a panic: "I can come by myself. If you don't go out, I...I will bite my tongue and commit suicide!"
Doesn't she like to be watched taking a bath and helping her take off her clothes? ? No, she firmly disagreed.
Xi Xiaoyuan stuck out her tongue and bit it deliberately, the servants were a little frightened, and then seeing Xi Xiaoyuan's serious look as if she really wanted to bite him, they finally agreed.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at the light mist floating in the bathtub alone, and rose petals floating on it...
